QuestInfo.name: [Soul Weapon] Murgoth's Soul Collector
QuestInfo.0: After a lot of work, you completed one of the soul marbles that Murgoth told you about. Happiness spreads across his skinny face. Talk to Murgoth.
QuestInfo.1: Murgoth promised to give you a special gift every time you complete a soul. Talk to Murgoth each time you complete one.
QuestInfo.2: You showed Murgoth the soul and got many gifts.
